verdict.rationale: A payments platform could plausibly offer user-configurable background automations such as scheduled payouts or rules, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only adjacent items: platform-side 'automated onboarding, split payments, and settlements', a merchant-driven recurring charge using a saved card_id, webhook notifications, and an MCP bridge for agents. None of these is a documented capability that lets users set up automations that run autonomously in the background.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
